---
title: "GO Enrichment Analysis Across Dementia Transitions"
params:
  top_n: 1000
---

## Load Packages

```{r}
#| label: load-packages
#| message: false
#| warning: false

pacman::p_load(clusterProfiler, org.Hs.eg.db, install = FALSE)
```


## Set the top number of genes

```{r}
#| label: set-top-number
#| message: false

# top_n <- 2000
```

## Load Data

### Background Genes

```{r}
#| label: load-data
#| message: false

# Load background genes
background_genes <- read_rds(here("data/upon_request/background_great_genes.rds"))

glimpse(background_genes)
```

### Significant genes

The significant genes are the ones that are associated with the significant CpGs.


```{r}
sig_genes <- read_rds(here(glue("pathway_analysis/01_genes/output/top{params$top_n}_all_genes_df.rds")))

glimpse(sig_genes)
```


## Get Entrez IDs for significant genes

```{r}

sig_genes_entrez <- sig_genes |> 
  # select(genes) |> 
  # distinct() |> 
  mutate(entrez_id = AnnotationDbi::select(org.Hs.eg.db, keys = genes, keytype = "SYMBOL", columns = "ENTREZID")$ENTREZID)

glimpse(sig_genes_entrez)
```


## Run GO Enrichment

### Define the function

```{r}
  run_go_enrichment <- function(gene_tbl, target_condition, background_genes) {
    # Perform GO analysis
    enrichGO(
      gene = gene_tbl %>% filter(condition == target_condition) %>% pull(entrez_id), 
      universe = unique(background_genes$entrez_id), 
      OrgDb = org.Hs.eg.db,
      ont = "BP",
      pAdjustMethod = "BH", 
      pvalueCutoff = 0.05,
      qvalueCutoff = 0.2,
      readable = TRUE
    )
  }

# Test the function

run_go_enrichment(sig_genes_entrez, "mci2incid", background_genes)
```


### Run GO Enrichment for all conditions

```{r}
enrich_results <- unique(sig_genes_entrez$condition) |> 
  set_names() |> 
  # head(2) |> 
  map(~run_go_enrichment(sig_genes_entrez, .x, background_genes))

enrich_results
```


### Convert to tibble

```{r}
enrich_results_tibble <- map_dfr(enrich_results, ~as_tibble(.x@result), .id = "condition")

glimpse(enrich_results_tibble)
```



## Save Results

```{r}
# Save results
fs::dir_create(here("pathway_analysis/02_gene_ontology/output"))
write_rds(enrich_results, here(glue("pathway_analysis/02_gene_ontology/output/top{params$top_n}_all_GO_enrichResult.rds")))
write_rds(enrich_results_tibble, here(glue("pathway_analysis/02_gene_ontology/output/top{params$top_n}_all_GO_results.rds")))
```
